items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: Jimmy Smith, the famous organ player, sat in with us the whole — we did “Who’s Afraid of Virginia Woolf” and I got to write out some parts.

ctx.x: Yeah I’ve often wondered about that, you have everyone from Sonny & Cher to Renee Fleming on the show and there’s got to be some very hip musicians who not only can play anything but can hear anything and play in the correct style and so forth.

Yes, yes. Well we had a remarkable rhythm section on that show, you know Anton Fig on drums, Will Lee on bass, and the guys had been everywhere, played everything. And a lot of times artists would come on, “Well hey, I played on the original record, yeah I know the part.” So but yeah, that’s one of the necessary skills for a TV musician because you never know who they’re going to put on there. You know? Snoop — I wrote charts, horn charts for Snoop Dogg one time. We did that song called “Get the Funk Out of My…
What happens to all this music that you’ve written?
